description: This file defines the PopupSmarty class, which extends ListViewSmarty to handle the presentation and processing of popup list views within SuiteCRM. It manages templates, search forms, data processing, and display logic for popup interfaces.

classes.name: PopupSmarty
classes.description: A class that manages the display and processing of pop-up list views, including template rendering, search forms, sorting, and data handling within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PopupSmarty object, loads templates, and sets up search forms and context menus.

methods.name: processArrowVars
methods.description: Assigns image attributes for sort arrows in the Smarty templates.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes data for display, including setting up columns, context menus, and search forms, then renders the Smarty template.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the Smarty template with all assigned variables, handling language packs, headers, and associated data.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the Smarty environment, including ordering, filtering, and search setup, then calls _setup.

methods.name: _setup
methods.description: Performs the internal setup for the popup, including metadata, search definitions, display columns, and processing parameters.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Generates the SQL WHERE clause based on search form inputs and meta-statements.

methods.name: _build_field_defs
methods.description: Builds form field definitions for the search form based on metadata and request parameters.

methods.name: _getAddForm
methods.description: Constructs HTML for the quick create form, if metadata allows.

methods.name: _getAddFormHeader
methods.description: Generates the header HTML for the quick create form.

methods.name: getQuickCreate
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the quick create popup interface.
